plan: Final deliverable produced as a single integrated experiment-design document under twelve required sections plus Appendix A.1. Headline: design-only with no claim of execution. Numerical positions in the per-task table follow the FuseLLM paper (Wan et al., ICLR 2024, arXiv:2401.10491), Table 1, and are flagged as approximate pending paper-PDF verification. Five locked researcher policies adopted verbatim: Llama-2-7B as baseline and constituent, 7-task CS suite with OpenBookQA in appendix, primary = mean accuracy, tie-breaker = at-least-5-of-7 wins, robustness = paired permutation p plus Cohen d_z plus bootstrap CI, per-source attribution as analytical subsection, mandatory negative-finding clause in the Reporting Plan. Sections in order: Title and Research Question, Hypotheses (H1 vs H0), Models and Variants, Benchmark and Task Suite, Zero-Shot Protocol, Controls and Baselines, Metrics and Operational Definition, Analysis Plan, Threats to Validity, Feasibility Assessment under bubblewrap, Reporting Plan with Negative-Finding Clause, Reproducibility Checklist. Appendix A.1 covers OpenBookQA as held-out probe.
